notes: Photograph instead of a drawn chart (site review 2026-10): the Strait of Messina, where Odysseus sailed between Scylla and Charybdis, as seen by NASA's ASTER instrument (internal tidal waves in the strait, Mount Etna out of frame). Public domain: NASA/GSFC/METI/ERSDAC/JAROS and U.S./Japan ASTER Science Team, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Messina-waves-image.jpg. Rotated a quarter turn, cropped to the chart's proportions and tinted blue (multiply). The route and ports I-III are drawn over it. The chart has no visible title: chartTitle from process-landing content is the accessible name only.
